about: Atomic settings writer parity vectors: the reviewed TypeScript AtomicSettingsWriter is the reference.
STILL_UPDATE_ATOMIC_VECTORS=1 pnpm --filter @still/core exec vitest run atomic-settings-writer-vectors. Do not edit by hand.
Replayed by StillKit AtomicSettingsWriterVectorTests.swift and the compiled-host test in atomic-settings.test.ts.
Each step: the command, whether the writer applied or refused it, the commit's intentCommitted, a diagnostic summary,
and digest = SHA-256 hex of the key-sorted, whitespace-free JSON of the complete stored record after the step
(UTF-16 key order; "null" when absent). The final step also keeps the record. A refusal never writes. All values are synthetic.

Fixed identities: account A 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111, account B 22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222, session cccccccc-cccc-cccc-cccc-cccccccccccc, lineage aaaaaaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa, server time 2026-10-02T00:00:00Z.

cases.name: compaction/never-linked-journal-stays-bounded
cases.about: A never-linked account-free journal keeps only the newest request per field, so 72 deliberate edits never reach the 64-request pause.

cases.name: compaction/full-journal-admits-the-next-edit
cases.about: A persisted full never-linked journal (64 requests) compacts on the next edit instead of pausing.

cases.name: compaction/rank-ties-and-multi-field-bodies-survive
cases.about: Compaction ranks by (baseRevision, localStep), not array position, keeps every exact-rank tie and never rewrites a multi-field request.

cases.name: compaction/epoch-absent-journal-stays-immutable
cases.about: Without proof of a never-repointed record (syncEpoch absent) the journal is immutable and the 65th edit is held with pending-limit.

cases.name: compaction/first-link-transfers-the-compacted-journal
cases.about: The compacted never-linked journal transfers at first link with original identities and binds the first receipt.

cases.name: queued-updatedAt/ordering-hold-and-unchanged-keep-the-stamp
cases.about: A held choice (step-saturated ordering hold) and an unchanged answer that clears it never restamp settings.updatedAt; only an allocated edit does.

cases.name: queued-updatedAt/awaiting-anchor-hold-keeps-the-stamp
cases.about: A first-linked record without an anchor holds new choices (awaiting-anchor) without restamping, then acknowledgement clears them.

cases.name: queued-updatedAt/ownership-hold-keeps-the-stamp
cases.about: An unconfirmed previous-ownership record holds choices without restamping; an empty account keeps differing local choices held.

cases.name: queued-updatedAt/pending-limit-keeps-the-stamp
cases.about: At 64 account-bound requests the next choice is held with pending-limit and settings.updatedAt stays at the last allocated edit.

cases.name: pauses-projection/queued-commit-normalizes-retired-pauses
cases.about: Every write projects the retired legacy pauses list as empty, as the TypeScript writer's projection does.

cases.name: pauses-projection/queued-commit-adds-the-empty-pauses-list
cases.about: A modern record saved without a pauses member gains the empty legacy projection on the next write.

cases.name: pauses-projection/acknowledgement-normalizes-retired-pauses
cases.about: Acknowledgement writes the same empty pauses projection.

cases.name: scope-members/pending-scope-identity-is-member-wise
cases.about: Request scope identity is (accountId, generation, sessionId); an unknown extra member does not retire a current request.

cases.name: scope-members/acknowledged-scope-identity-is-member-wise
cases.about: An acknowledgement whose captured scope carries an unknown extra member still applies to the same scope.

cases.name: saturation-order/no-op-answers-precede-the-sequence-bound
cases.about: At the sequence bound, the same verified session and a stale-scope acknowledgement are no-ops; real changes are refused untouched.

cases.name: saturation-order/same-session-precedes-the-generation-bound
cases.about: At the generation bound the same verified session is a no-op, while entering another account is refused untouched.

cases.name: legacy-commit/absent-record-saves-a-never-repointed-record
cases.about: A choice on an absent record saves the defaults with that choice, no sync metadata and syncEpoch 0, then converts identically.

cases.name: legacy-commit/stamps-never-move-backward
cases.about: A legacy choice is stamped after the saved updatedAt even when the device clock is behind it.

cases.name: baseline/acknowledgement-keeps-newer-local-intent
cases.about: An acknowledgement of an older request keeps the newer queued intent and its rank.

cases.name: baseline/account-switch-retires-pending-and-adopts-the-account
cases.about: Switching accounts retires queued requests, pauses ownership-unconfirmed and adopts a non-empty account.

cases.name: baseline/never-linked-empty-account-first-link
cases.about: A never-linked first link into an empty account carries the local choices as bound requests.
